data.navTitle: 房间模型、镜片与窗边支架
data.title: Light on the model room

memoryNodes.cue: It shows an image of the window.
Maya can see how the parts fit together.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 玛雅能看出部件如何组织。

memoryNodes.cue: Moving the lamp affects physical balance.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 移动台灯影响实物平衡。

data.situation:
The next bench held a model of the centre’s room. A small mirror reflected the window on the opposite wall. Dr Chen used the model to illustrate how changing the lamp’s position changed the light. Maya could see the structure clearly: a base, three walls and a roof that lifted off. A narrow stand lost its balance when Jo put the lamp too far to one side. Jo: The room looked simple in the photograph.
Maya: The model shows how complex it is. The furniture, light and doors all affect each other.
Dr Chen: Yes. Do not make the design more complicated than it needs to be. A small change may be easier to explain and maintain.
Jo moved the lamp towards the middle, and the stand stayed level.

readingBlocks.en: The next bench held a model of the centre’s room. A small mirror reflected the window on the opposite wall. Dr Chen used the model to illustrate how changing the lamp’s position changed the light. Maya could see the structure clearly: a base, three walls and a roof that lifted off. A narrow stand lost its balance when Jo put the lamp too far to one side.
readingBlocks.zh: 隔壁台上摆着中心房间的模型。一块小镜子映出对面墙上的窗户。陈博士用模型说明，改变台灯位置会怎样改变光线。玛雅可以看清结构：底座、三面墙和可以拿起的屋顶。乔把台灯放得太靠一边，窄支架失去平衡。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: The room looked simple in the photograph.
Maya: The model shows how complex it is. The furniture, light and doors all affect each other.
Dr Chen: Yes. Do not make the design more complicated than it needs to be. A small change may be easier to explain and maintain.
Jo moved the lamp towards the middle, and the stand stayed level.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：照片里的房间看起来很简单。
玛雅：模型显示它有多复杂。家具、光线和门会相互影响。
陈博士：对。不要把设计弄得比实际需要更复杂。小改动可能更容易解释和维护。
乔把台灯向中间移，支架保持平稳。

glossary.note: 本例镜面映像；原中文反映较宽，不计表示事实或思考义。
glossary.example: The mirror reflects the window opposite it.
The model illustrates how the light enters the room.
glossary.exampleZh: 模型说明光线怎样进入房间。

externalEvidence.definition: clarify by giving an example of

glossary.zh: 各部分的安排与组成；结构
glossary.note: 本例实物各部件的组织；语法结构原例 R00894 另留待补。
glossary.example: The model shows the structure of the room.

externalEvidence.definition: the manner of construction of something and the arrangement of its parts

glossary.zh: 使物体保持稳定的重量分布；平衡
glossary.note: 名词，physical balance；不是账户余额。
glossary.example: The stand lost its balance when the lamp moved to one side.
glossary.exampleZh: 台灯移向一侧时，支架失去平衡。

glossary.zh: 由多个相互关联部分构成的；复杂的
glossary.note: 与complicated意义有重叠，本例强调关联部分。
glossary.example: The room is a complex system of light, furniture and movement.
glossary.exampleZh: 房间是由光线、家具和移动组成的复杂系统。

externalEvidence.definition: complicated in structure; consisting of interconnected parts

glossary.zh: 难以理解或处理的；复杂的
glossary.note: 与complex并非绝对对立；本例强调不好处理。
glossary.example: An extra set of controls would make the design more complicated.
glossary.exampleZh: 额外加一组控制器会让设计更复杂。
